price_lines: +Yes. Uploads have a daily and a monthly limit:
+Hobby: 1 GiB a day and 3 GiB a month
+Paid tiers and Enterprise: 30 GiB a day and 100 GiB a month, including a tier your workspace pays for
+The daily limit resets at 00:00 UTC. The monthly limit resets at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each calendar month, not on your billing date.
